context_for_next_testing_agent: Task submissions bug fix verified. Key findings: 1) POST /api/course/tasks/{task_id}/submit - correctly saves submissions to database using $or query to support both 'post_type' and 'type' fields, 2) GET /api/course/tasks/{task_id}/submissions - returns submissions with enriched student details, 3) PUT /api/course/tasks/{task_id}/submissions/{submission_id}/grade - allows teachers/admins to grade submissions, 4) GET /api/course/{subject_id}/posts?post_type=task - includes submissions_count for tasks. All endpoints use $or: [{'post_type': 'task'}, {'type': 'task'}] to support both old and new task formats.

submit_task.purpose: Submit a task as a student

get_task_submissions.purpose: Get all submissions for a task with student details

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Student task submissions not appearing in teacher portal - 'Entregada: 0' shown
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Query used only 'post_type: task' but some tasks were saved with 'type: task'
